content.title: Tilray CEO says THC drink regulation will benefit cannabis companies
content.description:
President Trump is expected to sign an executive order that could reclassify marijuana from a Schedule I to a Schedule III drug, which would enable cannabis to be federally classified for medical use.

Tilray Brands (TLRY) Chairman and CEO Irwin Simon sits down with Julie Hyman to share his outlook on his company's THC and hemp products in relation to Congress' latest budget bill that could see a ban on most hemp-derived THC products by late 2026.

content.title: Trump expected to sign EO to reclassify marijuana as soon as Monday, CNBC says
content.summary: Cannabis stocks jumped on Friday following reports that President Donald Trump will significantly ease federal restrictions on marijuana, with an executive order seen as coming as soon as Monday, CNBC’s Alex Harring and Brandon Gomez report. Trump is expected to use an executive order to instruct federal agencies to reclassify marijuana as a less regulated Schedule III drug from a Schedule I, the Washington Post reported on Thursday.
